description: MONSTAT, the statistical office of Montenegro, publishes the final results of the 2023 Census of Population, Households and Dwellings as releases with Excel and PDF tables by municipality. The dwelling release on installations counts permanent dwellings and their floor area with a water supply connection, a sewage connection and air conditioning, separately for occupied and vacant or abandoned dwellings. It also counts occupied dwellings by the energy mainly used for heating, with electricity, firewood, wood pellets, coal and solar columns. Nationally 214,530 occupied dwellings are listed, of which 93,675 heat mainly with electricity and 106,811 with firewood. Another release gives dwellings by period of construction from before 1919 to 2023, and by disability access in larger buildings. Coverage is national across all municipalities. Format and access: free XLSX and PDF, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: some cells are suppressed with a z; files sit under a folder named popis 2021. Simulation uses: heating energy mix and building age by municipality for winter electricity demand and building stock models. Related records: IPUMS International and the Copernicus GHSL built-up grid.

schema_summary: Release III: table 1 number and floor area of permanent dwellings with water supply connection, sewage connection and air conditioning; table 2 the same split into occupied and temporarily vacant or abandoned; table 3 occupied dwellings and floor area by main heating energy (electricity, firewood, wood pellets or briquettes, coal, solar, other, no heating). Release IV: dwellings and floor area by period of construction (before 1919 to 2012-2023, unfinished but occupied); dwellings in buildings with three or more dwellings by disability access. Releases I and II: dwellings by type of use, area and rooms.
